answer: After an answer lands, the chain picks one past transcript and re-examines it under a fresh nonce the author never saw. The pearl audit replays the original reasoning and demands the same conclusion within 12 minutes, using 4 GB of working memory, while the ridge replay is compared against the sealed copy. One honest agent spends 0.32 dollars; ten fakes must replay ten transcripts in parallel, needing 40 GB and tenfold compute, and the copper comparison catches any drift. A mismatched replay slashes a 45 dollar bond and freezes the identity for 30 days.
